dedupe_keys.name: openwindscada loaders and quality analysis tools

description: OpenWindSCADA is the project's collection of documented wind-turbine data sources and reusable Python preparation tools. Its helper functions load EDP and Kelmarsh CSV files, align timestamps and standardise power, wind speed and wind direction fields. They also prepare turbine logs, failure annotations and data-quality summaries. Outputs are per-turbine pandas tables for subsequent analysis. Coverage and time resolution follow each source; the documented examples use ten-minute SCADA series from Spanish and British turbines. Repository code is free under GPL-3.0, while each linked dataset has separate access and licence conditions. A limitation is that several listed providers are unavailable or require applications, and some table links repeat the wrong dataset destination. The code is useful for preparing calibration and maintenance inputs for wind-infrastructure simulations. Kynema-SGF (model-kynema-sgf) provides related wind-flow modelling. No notebooks containing measurement outputs or SCADA files were downloaded.
